description: This file contains the implementation of the Account Returns controller class for the OpenCart platform. It manages user interactions related to product return processes, including listing returns, viewing return details, adding a new return, and handling return information. The class interacts with models to fetch data, manages pagination and breadcrumbs, enforces authentication, and renders views for various return-related pages.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class handling product returns for the account section, providing methods to list returns, view return details, and add new return requests.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of all returns, handles pagination, and prepares data for the returns list view.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a specific return, including order details, product info, and history.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles the process of submitting a new return request, including form display and token setup.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of a return form, validating data, handling captcha, and creating a new return record, returning JSON response.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays a success page after a return is successfully submitted.
